cell_line: The immortalized normal human thyroid epithelial cell line Nthy-ORI (Sigma) was routinely cultured in RPMI 1640 growth media with l-glutamine (300 mg/l) (Sigma), sodium pyruvate and nonessential amino acids (1%) (Cellgro/Mediatech), supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum (Peak Serum) and penicillin-streptomycin (200 IU/l) (Cellgro/Mediatech) at 37°C, 5% CO2, and 100% humidity.
